subject.title: refactor: own model discovery by runtime lifecycle

question: Should the released `loadModelCatalog` Plugin SDK API remain a supported compatibility wrapper with its documented lifecycle semantics, or should maintainers require a different deprecation and migration contract before this refactor lands?
rationale: The branch intentionally changes the ownership and refresh model behind a released plugin-facing API. Source review can establish mechanics, but it cannot choose the repository’s permanent external compatibility promise.

options.title: Accept the compatibility wrapper
options.body: Keep `loadModelCatalog` as the deprecated bridge, document the lifecycle snapshot semantics, and land with focused external-plugin compatibility tests.

options.title: Require a stronger migration contract
options.body: Define an explicit replacement timeline, plugin migration guidance, and any required legacy refresh behavior before merge.

options.title: Narrow the public change
options.body: Keep the lifecycle refactor internal and defer new public catalog APIs until an SDK owner approves their long-term shape.

recommendation.title: Accept the compatibility wrapper
recommendation.body: Keep `loadModelCatalog` as the deprecated bridge, document the lifecycle snapshot semantics, and land with focused external-plugin compatibility tests.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete authored the lifecycle and SDK compatibility implementation and is the clearest available routing point for the intended contract.
